name: Party Identification 24 Choice
definition: Choice of identification of a party. The party can be identified by providing a BIC or a MIC.

BICOrBEI.name: BIC Or BEI
BICOrBEI.definition: Code allocated to a financial or non-financial institution by the ISO 9362 Registration Authority, as described in ISO 9362 "Banking - Banking telecommunication messages - Business identifier code (BIC)".

MIC.name: MIC
MIC.definition: Market Identifier Code. Identification of a financial market, as stipulated in the norm ISO 10383 "Codes for exchanges and market identifications".
